text: A formula is in conjunctive normal form (CNF) iff it is:
choices: a conjunction of disjunctions of literals
a disjunction of conjunctions of literals
explanation: CNF: φ = C₁∧C₂∧⋯∧Cₙ where each Cᵢ = l₁∨⋯∨lₖ (a clause) and each lⱼ is a literal. Every propositional formula is equivalent to one in CNF.
